records.title: Multi-scale frequency-guided two-stream network for hyperspectral anomaly detection
records.abstractSummary: MFTNet decomposes encoded features into high-frequency anomaly and low-frequency background parts, enhances the high-frequency branch, uses self-attention to recover background, and averages separate anomaly/background detection maps; abstract reports six datasets and 13 baselines.

records.title: Multi-domain universal representation learning for hyperspectral object tracking
records.abstractLevel: ScienceDirect article page and abstract information
records.abstractSummary: DaSSP-Net combines domain adapters with a band-invariant spatial-spectral prompt to adapt a foundation model across VIS, NIR and RedNIR domains; page reports HOT2020, HOT2022, HOT2023 and IMEC25 experiments and four AUC values.

records.title: Pixel-Wise Shuffling with Collaborative Sparsity for Melanoma Hyperspectral Image Classification
records.abstractSummary: The method combines collaborative sparse unmixing, pixel-wise shuffling and inter-similarity hybrid attention for histology-verified melanoma HSI classification; abstract reports 73.34% overall accuracy with 20% training data.
